useCase: 相机型号识别、来源归属和AI内容验证
mechanism: 使用 a deep 神经网络 (DnCNN) to extract the noise residual of an image, 其 contains the camera-specific 噪声模式. Authentic photos have consistent noise signatures from the imaging sensor, while AI生成的 images show synthetic or absent 噪声模式s.
accuracy: 高 - 87-95% for distinguishing camera images from AI生成的 content
name: 噪声印记分析
parameters: Network: DnCNN-17 layers, Patch size: 64x64, Stride: 32, Correlation metric: normalized cross-相关性
description: 提取 and 分析 the camera sensor 噪声模式 (noiseprint) embedded图像中的. AI生成的 images lack authentic sensor noise signatures.

references.title: Cozzolino, D. & Verdoliva, L. (2020). Noiseprint: A CNN-Based Camera Model Fingerprint. IEEE TIFS.
Mandelli, S. et al. (2020). CNN-Based Fast Source Device Identification. IEEE SPL.

strengths:
• Very high 准确度 for camera vs AI distinction
• Captures camera-specific noise fingerprint
• Deep learning enhances noise extraction
• Robust to moderate post-processing
limitations:
• Requires trained DnCNN model
• Heavy denoising destroys 噪声模式s
• Social media compression degrades 准确度
• New camera models may not be in training data
